The forecast for March says cold, so why not extend the indoor season with a Trial course? You can use it to improve your balance, brake control and obstacle technique. The course suits all playful bikers who love off-road riding, or anyone simply interested in the Trial discipline.

Training will take place in our new heated club hall (Prague-Nedvězí). We'll lend you a bike, because a mountain bike isn't suitable for indoor Trial training. The number of bikes also limits the maximum number of riders, which gives us the chance to focus on you more.

In March we'll only run the Friday course, with the option of individual training outside this date. In case of a one-off absence, one replacement day will be set for everyone who can't attend all 3 sessions.

Training is led by Lukáš Valný, Czech amateur champion, Elite Trial rider and a rider with racing experience in other disciplines (Enduro). Lukáš grew up as a rider alongside other elite riders and legends in our club MTB & Trial Mraveniště Říčany, and he's an MTB enthusiast and collector.



LOCATION:

The course takes place in Nedvězí (Prague-Nedvězí, near Říčany), where an even bigger and better-equipped hall than last year is ready for this year. So you can train regardless of weather and light conditions. The venue is accessible by car / bus. A modest shower and WC are available, including our own parking.

Mostly wooden obstacles on carpet / anti-slip tiles are available.

Hall location: Google Maps link

(it's a closed, guarded site, but open for vehicle entry)



SUITABLE FOR:

Men, women and children. Children only when accompanied by parents, on an individual basis. Ideal for beginners, amateur and professional riders.

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Courses and camps have limited capacity. You can check availability in the header of the camp description (booked / total capacity), as well as the price. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
